Maya (Prod Mktg): Hey team — coordinating the CaseLab customer story for the upcoming launch. Interview with Elaine (CaseLab CMO) is booked for Thu 4/14 10:00am PT. Need: interview transcript, one hero quote cleared by legal, two short pull-quotes for the launch post, a 30s social clip, and logo + headshot assets. @Nora can you confirm CS handoff and release signature flow? @legal-team need an expected review SLA. Also tying this into the webinar on 4/21 — want a benchmark slide.
Nora (CS): Yep, I’ll prepare the handoff doc and join the interview. I’ll own the release.
Carlos (Content): I can run the interview and pull quotes. Draft Qs below — will tweak if anyone has add-ons. Quick ask: can we get concrete KPIs from CaseLab (latency, throughput, cost %) so we can use hard numbers in the benchmark narrative?
Carlos (Content): ```Interview Qs:
1) What was the key driver for moving inference to Redwood?
2) Before vs after: throughput, latency, cost (numbers please).
3) Any operational wins (dev time, reliability)?
4) Quote request: one sentence on business impact.
```
Jun (Design): I'll start on the hero template + social clip layout. Need a high‑res headshot and brand logo files (SVG preferred). If CaseLab has brand guidelines that require approvals, flag now.
legal-team: We can turn around quote and release review within 48 hours once we have final quote strings and the signed release. We need the signed release uploaded to the legal share (S3 link or Google Drive). Also prefer numeric precision in quotes — avoid ambiguous phrasing like "over half" unless audited.
Elaine (CaseLab): Happy to help — numbers we can share now: ~3.2x throughput on our peak pipeline and roughly 60% lower per‑request inference cost after moving to Redwood. I'll upload logos + signed release form by Tue EOD.
Priya (PM): For the webinar tie-in: can we reserve a demo segment for CaseLab? Thinking 10min demo + 5min live Q&A. @Maya @Carlos is that workable?
Carlos (Content): That works. I'll draft a 10min demo script and extract quotes live during the interview. Early hero quote candidate: "Redwood's routing cut our inference cost by over half while preserving output quality."
legal-team: Prefer "approximately 60%" instead of "over half" unless you can back the phrasing. If CaseLab confirms 60% we're good. Also ask Elaine to initial the quote line on the release.
Maya (Prod Mktg): Elaine confirmed 60% in the prior message — good. I'll upload assets to /assets/caselab/ once Elaine posts them. For now, Carlos, can you drop the transcript excerpt here after the interview so Legal can flag any redlines?
Carlos (Content): Posting rough transcript excerpt from today’s runthrough: ```
Elaine: "We saw about a 3.2x jump in throughput and roughly a 60% reduction in inference cost after switching to Redwood. That allowed our ML team to iterate faster and ship convos to production sooner."
```
Carlos (Content): Marking potential hero quote: "We saw about a 3.2x jump in throughput and roughly a 60% reduction in inference cost after switching to Redwood." Pull quotes: "60% reduction in inference cost" and "3.2x throughput".
legal-team: That phrasing is fine. Please include any backup metric snapshot (dashboard screenshot or CSV) with the release so we have provenance in case of a claim check.
Rishi (Ops): Tentative launch timeline: 4/14 interview; 4/16 draft post + legal review; 4/18 final assets & design; 4/20 embargo check; 4/21 publish + webinar. :rocket:
Maya (Prod Mktg): Perfect. Action items: Carlos — draft post + clip; Jun — design assets and social cut; Nora — confirm signed release in S3; Legal — formal quote approval once transcript + backup data uploaded; Priya — lock webinar slot and outline. I’ll send calendar invites and a short checklist. :thumbsup:
Nora (CS): Noted — will upload signed release to S3 at s3://redwood-marketing/caselab/release_signed.pdf by Tue EOD.
Jun (Design): I'll put the hero mock in Figma and share link after I get the headshot.
Elaine (CaseLab): Uploaded logos and release to the drive (link posted in DM). Looking forward to the webinar.
Maya (Prod Mktg): Thanks everyone — I’ll follow up with a single doc that tracks quotes, legal approvals, and asset links.
